text:
maria_sales: FYI we got an urgent medtech ask. Customer wants a 2-week pilot with traffic pinned to Canada + Brazil, 95th <200ms, and full subprocessor list. They said "no copies outside country" in the sec questionnaire. Need guidance + ballpark pricing today.

diego_presales: Quick questions: model size and expected peak windows?

maria_sales: Model ~7B, avg seq 512, peaks to ~45 qps for ~20-30m nightly, baseline ~4 qps.

samir_sre: Hosted in ca-central1 can meet latency. sa-east1 hosted is patchy; to enforce no cross-border copies we'd need Dedicated or Private in-region. Edge pools alone won't satisfy "no copies" requirement.

anya_security: Important: medtech = potential PHI. "No copies outside country" is a high bar. Hosted multi-tenant can't guarantee that for short trials because of backups/replication/metrics pipelines. Options: 1) Temp Dedicated in each country, 2) Private (VPC/on-prem). BYOK helps but doesn't stop metadata/replication.

maria_sales: They want a rough cost comparison: hosted per-token vs 2-week dedicated burst. Any ballpark?

samir_sre: Very rough: 2x A10G-equivalent pool per region for 14 days incl networking/provisioning ~ $12k-$20k per region (placeholder). Hosted per-token likely cheaper for compute, but fails residency constraint. I can tighten numbers if ops confirms quotas.

ops_ashley: I can check infra quotas and give an exact reserved cost by EOD. Need confirm of qps and seq (we have those). Also confirm if they'd accept single-country (Canada only) first to reduce cost.

noah_legal: If they insist on "no copies outside country" we need legal to review subprocessor disclosures and possibly a bespoke contract clause. I'll unblock once security posts the subproc list.

diego_presales: Suggested routing config snippet to enforce country pinning (for Dedicated):
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "country_pin",
  "allowed_countries": ["CA"],
  "failover": "none"
}
```

maria_sales: Can someone produce the subprocessor manifest for hosted vs dedicated (minimal set)? I'll send the sec questionnaire back to them with that.

anya_security: I'll assemble subproc manifest: cloud infra, metrics backend, logs, kms. For Dedicated the list shrinks (we control more layers). I'll attach SOC2 and PHI checklist summary here when ready.

samir_sre: Also note: monitoring agents and trace backends may surface metadata. For absolute residency we recommend Private deployment.

maria_sales: Timeline to communicate to the customer?

ops_ashley: Timeline: quota check + provisional pricing by EOD today, security subproc draft by EOD, legal review next day. If customer signs PO we can provision Dedicated ~48-72 hours. Blockers: legal approval of subproc list + budget signoff.

diego_presales: I'll draft a one-page trade-offs note (latency vs cost vs residency) to help their SOC team.

maria_sales: Great — I'll update customer: propose temp Dedicated in Canada (optional Brazil), explain BYOK limitations, give rough costs and timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
